description: Change the body of a message you sent, for example to fix a typo or rephrase it, or revert it to what you first sent. Give the complete new body, not a diff. Participants whose client supports edits see the new text marked as edited; the original stays stored and visible to them, so this does not retract anything. Only your own sent messages can be edited, and only the body: not the topic, recipients or attachments. Fails on drafts (change those before sending) and terminal messages.

text.description: the complete new body; null reverts to the original

name: edit_message

changed.description: false when the body already read that way and nothing was sent

edit_id.description: the edit now in force; null when the message has none

title: Edit sent fmsg message
